Example Federal Credit Union reports record membership growth in 2025

ANYTOWN, ST, March 3, 2026 — Example Federal Credit Union today announced its results for the year ended December 31, 2025.

Membership grew 4.2 percent to 212,000 members, the largest annual increase in the credit union's history. Total assets reached $3.1 billion at year end, up from $2.9 billion a year earlier.

Digital adoption continued to accelerate. More than 68 percent of members were enrolled in digital banking at year end, and mobile deposits accounted for 41 percent of all deposits made in the fourth quarter.

"Our members told us they wanted faster onboarding and a mobile experience that works the way they do," said Jordan Example, President and Chief Executive Officer. "We opened 18,400 new accounts in 2025 and more than half of them were opened online."

The credit union also reported a net worth ratio of 10.8 percent, well above the 7 percent threshold the National Credit Union Administration defines as well capitalized.

About Example Federal Credit Union

Founded in 1952, Example Federal Credit Union is a member-owned financial cooperative serving Anytown and the surrounding counties through fourteen branches and a full suite of digital banking services.
